name: Human-AI Hybrid Organization
description: Forward-looking organization structure designed for a workforce where humans and AI agents work side-by-side. Covers the radical implications of AI-augmented work: layer collapse (fewer managers needed), span expansion (humans manage larger teams with AI support), new org functions (AI ops, prompt engineering, model monitoring), and human-AI team composition (1 human + multiple AI agents as a unit). Designed for AI-first companies, AI startups, and forward-thinking enterprises exploring deep AI integration. For 10-500 total 'workers' (human + AI agents).

org_structure.overview: The Human-AI Hybrid Org is a radical reimagining of the company structure for a world where AI agents are not just tools but team members. This structure assumes: AI agents can handle 30-70% of current knowledge worker tasks; humans shift from doing to orchestrating; the org chart becomes flatter because AI handles coordination; new roles emerge around AI workforce management. The org is organized around 'pods' — a human lead + 3-10 specialized AI agents — rather than traditional departments. Layer collapse means 2-3 layers max from IC to CEO. AI agents have defined roles, responsibilities, and 'on-call' rotations just like humans. The biggest culture shift: humans manage AI agents, AI agents coordinate with each other, and humans focus on judgment, creativity, relationships, and exception handling.

departments.name: Executive / AI Strategy
departments.description: Sets the AI-first vision, decides which work stays human and which goes to AI, manages the AI workforce budget (token/compute costs), and defines the ethical boundaries of AI delegation.

roles.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) — Human
roles.description: Sets AI-first vision, culture, and strategy. Makes final decisions on AI delegation boundaries. The most human-centric role in the org.

roles.title: Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
roles.description: Leads AI workforce strategy, model selection, AI safety, and AI team performance. The executive responsible for AI agent hiring (training/fine-tuning) and deployment.

roles.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO) — AI-Augmented
roles.description: Manages human+AI operations, resource allocation, token/compute budgeting, and cross-pod coordination. AI assistants handle 80% of reporting.

roles.title: Chief AI Ethics Officer
roles.description: Governs AI agent behavior, ensures alignment, handles AI-related incidents, manages AI workforce rights and transparency.

departments.name: AI Operations & Platform
departments.description: The 'HR department for AI agents.' Manages the AI workforce lifecycle: model selection, fine-tuning, prompt management, agent monitoring, and agent performance evaluation. Also manages the infrastructure that AI agents run on.

roles.title: Head of AI Operations
roles.description: Manages the AI operations team. Responsible for AI agent uptime, performance, quality, and cost. The 'VP of AI Talent.'

roles.title: AI Agent Manager
roles.description: Manages a fleet of AI agents — assigns them to pods, monitors their performance, handles failures, and manages their 'training' (prompt updates, RAG refreshes).

roles.title: Prompt Engineer / AI Trainer
roles.description: Designs, tests, and version-controls prompts and RAG configurations for AI agents. The equivalent of AI 'L&D.' Runs evaluations and continuous improvement.

roles.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
roles.description: Manages model serving infrastructure, token quotas, latency SLAs, cost tracking, and AI agent orchestration platforms.

roles.title: AI Safety & Monitoring Specialist
roles.description: Monitors AI agent behavior for drift, safety violations, and quality degradation. Manages guardrails and incident response for AI failures.

roles.title: AI Agents (various specialties)
roles.description: Specialized AI agents serving in pods across the org. Examples: Code Agent, Research Agent, Content Agent, Data Agent, Support Agent, Design Agent.

departments.name: Product Development (Human-AI Pods)
departments.description: The core product development engine — organized as human-led pods with AI agent team members. Each pod has a human lead who sets direction and handles judgment calls, while AI agents handle implementation, testing, documentation, and analysis.

roles.title: VP Product Development
roles.description: Leads product development organization. Manages pod leads, sets quality standards for human-AI collaboration.

roles.title: Pod Lead / Human Team Lead
roles.description: Leads a human-AI pod. Sets direction, handles ambiguity, makes judgment calls, reviews AI output. The most critical human role — manages 3-10 AI agents.

roles.title: Human Product Manager
roles.description: Defines product requirements, user research, prioritization. Works with AI agents to generate specs, analyze data, and track outcomes.

roles.title: Human Designer
roles.description: Sets design direction, creates design systems, handles creative strategy. AI agents generate design variants, assets, and prototypes to their direction.

roles.title: Human Reviewer / Quality Lead
roles.description: Reviews all AI agent output before it reaches customers. The 'human in the loop' for critical quality and safety gates.

roles.title: Pod AI Agents
roles.description: Code agents (implement features, write tests), document agents (write docs, update specs), test agents (run tests, check quality), analysis agents (review data, find issues), communication agents (write updates, summarize meetings).

departments.name: Human-Centric Functions
departments.description: Roles that remain inherently human — strategy, relationships, creativity, leadership, ethics, and culture. These functions are AI-augmented (AI helps analyze, draft, summarize) but human-led.

roles.title: Head of People & Culture (Human)
roles.description: Manages human employee experience, culture, development, and well-being. Manages the unique dynamics of humans working alongside AI agents.

roles.title: Human Strategist / BizOps
roles.description: Strategic analysis, competitive intelligence, business planning. Uses AI agents for research and modeling but makes strategic recommendations independently.

roles.title: Human Relationship Manager / Sales
roles.description: Handles customer relationships, enterprise sales, partnerships, and high-stakes negotiations. AI supports with research, proposals, and follow-ups.

roles.title: Human Ethics & Culture Lead
roles.description: Maintains human-centric culture, manages human-AI collaboration norms, handles human concerns about AI replacement, runs inclusion initiatives.

roles.title: Legal & Compliance (Human)
roles.description: Handles contracts, compliance, IP, regulatory matters. Uses AI for contract review and research but makes all determinations independently.

key_relationships: Pod leads are the most critical human role — they manage 3-10 AI agents and make the judgment calls. Their effectiveness determines the org's output quality.
AI Operations acts as 'HR for AI' — it trains, assigns, monitors, and retires AI agents. Pod leads request agents from AI Ops rather than hiring them directly.
Humans review AI output before it reaches customers. The review-to-release ratio should be 1:3 (one human review per 3 AI-produced outputs) and decreasing as trust grows.
AI agents have defined 'on-call' rotations just like humans. They self-monitor and escalate to human handlers when they detect errors or ambiguity.
The org chart has only 2-3 layers because AI handles coordination, reporting, and status tracking — traditional middle management is largely eliminated.
Talent strategy is radically different: hiring for judgment, creativity, and relationship skills over procedural execution. AI handles the execution.
Culture must actively prevent 'AI creep' — the gradual replacement of human judgment with AI recommendations. Humans are required to question AI output.
Compensation is different: humans get salary + equity + AI productivity bonus (share of value created by their AI agent team).
org_structure.org_chart_text:
CEO (Human)
├── CAIO (Chief AI Officer — Human)
│     ├── Head of AI Operations (Human)
│     │     ├── AI Agent Managers (Human)
│     │     │     ├── Code Agents (AI)
│     │     │     ├── Research Agents (AI)
│     │     │     ├── Content Agents (AI)
│     │     │     ├── Support Agents (AI)
│     │     │     └── Data Agents (AI)
│     │     ├── Prompt Engineers / AI Trainers (Human)
│     │     └── AI Safety & Monitoring (Human)
│     └── VP Product Development (Human)
│           ├── Pod Lead — Product (Human)
│           │     ├── Human PM
│           │     ├── Code Agents (AI)
│           │     ├── Test Agents (AI)
│           │     └── Doc Agents (AI)
│           ├── Pod Lead — Platform (Human)
│           │     ├── Human Designer
│           │     ├── Code Agents (AI)
│           │     └── Analysis Agents (AI)
│           └── Human Reviewers / Quality (Human)
│
├── COO (Human, AI-Augmented)
│     ├── Head of People & Culture (Human)
│     ├── Human Strategists / BizOps (Human)
│     ├── Sales / Relationships (Human)
│     └── Legal & Compliance (Human)
│
└── Chief AI Ethics Officer (Human)
      └── AI Ethics Board (Human + AI Advisors)

Note: AI agents are not direct reports in the traditional sense — they are assigned
by AI Ops to pods based on capability requirements. Humans manage AI agents;
AI agents coordinate with each other. Middle management is radically reduced.
Every human role is AI-augmented — but humans always make the final call.
